caption: לא נלחם בכלל
en: a proud army commander wearing a kippah and a plain old-fashioned uniform sitting at home on a chair reading a book with a blank cover, no weapons, only the one man in this panel, no text (does not fight at all)

caption: המלחמה הקלה
en: a proud army commander wearing a kippah and a plain old-fashioned uniform standing in front of a very low small garden fence, no weapons, only the one man in this panel, no text (the easy battle)

caption: המלחמה החזקה
en: a proud army commander wearing a kippah and a plain old-fashioned uniform standing determined before a huge tall stone fortress wall looking up at it, no weapons, only the one man in this panel, no text (the hard battle)

caption: שמח לעשות
en: a smiling boy wearing a kippah carrying a heavy cardboard box for his bearded father wearing a kippah who walks beside him, two figures only, no text (happy to do it)

caption: בורח הביתה
en: a boy wearing a kippah running away fast down a street, a heavy box left behind, only the one boy in this panel, no text (runs home)

caption: מתלונן ולא עושה
en: a boy wearing a kippah with crossed arms and a grumpy face standing next to a heavy cardboard box without lifting it, only the one boy in this panel, no text (complains and does nothing)

caption: הכול נשאר אותו דבר
en: the same gray stone path under the same gray sky shown unchanged, a boy wearing a kippah standing on it, only the one boy in this panel, no text (everything stays the same)

caption: הכול הפך לרע
en: a sunny flower garden slowly turning gray and wilted, a sad boy wearing a kippah standing in it, only the one boy in this panel, no text (everything turns bad)

caption: הכול הפך לטוב
en: a gloomy gray road turning into a sunny blooming garden with a happy boy wearing a kippah standing in it, only the one boy in this panel, no text (everything turns good)

caption: חלשה יותר
en: a boy wearing a kippah holding a tiny flickering candle in a dark room, only the one boy in this panel, no text (weaker)

caption: נפסקת לגמרי
en: a boy wearing a kippah turning his back and walking away from a lit lantern on a table, only the one boy in this panel, no text (stops completely)

caption: חזקה יותר
en: a smiling boy wearing a kippah holding a big bright warm lantern in the rain with the sun coming out behind him, only the one boy in this panel, no text (stronger)
